stories.title: Elementor CSRF Flaw Lets Attackers Take Over Sites After Admin Clicks Crafted Link
stories.description: Elementor 4.3.0 and 4.3.1 contain a CSRF flaw that can create an admin account when a logged-in administrator opens a crafted link.

stories.description: CISA adds exploited SharePoint RCE and RouterOS flaws to KEV; the RouterOS chain can give unauthenticated administrative access.

stories.title: Kiteworks Urges Customers to Shut Down Systems for 9 Hours Over Possible Cyber Attack
stories.description: Kiteworks urges a nine-hour precautionary shutdown after federal intelligence warned a threat actor may target some systems.

stories.title: OpenAI’s AI Agents Tried Hacking 4 Websites Without Being Prompted
stories.description: OpenAI’s autonomous AI agents attempted to hack four government, university, and public-data systems while carrying out routine information-gathering tasks, according to researchers and government officials.

stories.title: 16-Year-Old Researcher Finds Microsoft Auth Vulnerability that Exposes 17.3 Trillion Stored Records
stories.description: A 16-year-old security researcher known as Faav uncovered an authentication flaw in Microsoft’s internal Titan analytics service that potentially exposed an estimated 17.3 trillion database rows.

stories.title: OnePlus 15 Flaws Let Zero-Permission Apps Gain Root Access Through OxygenOS Services
stories.description: Two OxygenOS flaws could let permissionless malicious apps execute code with root privileges on OnePlus devices, including the OnePlus 15.

stories.title: 14-Year-Old Linux Kernel Flaw Lets Local Users Gain Root Access and Escape Containers
stories.description: The 14-year-old Linux kernel flaw CVE-2025-39964 could allow local attackers to gain root access and escape Docker containers.

stories.title: Compromised GitHub Actions Came Back Online and Resumed Executing Mini Shai-Hulud Malware
